newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bankers Trust started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bankers Trust started.

text.p: -- Nomura Securities said it initiated coverage of Bankers Trust New York Corp as a buy.
-- set a 12-month price target of $105 a share.
-- said Bankers Trust shares are trading at a discount to Nomura's bank sector average.
-- said Bankers Trust's new management team has sought to implement a culture that places a higher value on client relationships, while also working to nuture creativity.
-- said Bankers Trust has excess regulatory capital that provides financial flexibility for share repurchases or new initiates.
